note: acquisition à PSMC d'une usine de plaquettes à Tongluo (comté de Miaoli, Taïwan), contrepartie en numéraire payable par versements
quote: On March 15, 2026, we completed the acquisition of a wafer fabrication facility in Tongluo, Miaoli County, Taiwan, from Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation for cash consideration to be paid in installments totaling $1.8 billion.
